svg.title: Halftone Gambit, 3d chess in ascii glyphs
svg.desc: Plate X. The title HALFTONE GAMBIT, drawn as a cloud of points, because the code is not public. A pipeline of five boxes: rules in chess.js, the board, one glyph shader, a dither pass, and the screen. Stockfish in a worker and a semantic DOM board hang off the rules. Dashed, not built: drag to move, and a measurement on mobile.
